labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run). Clean proposed/approved on the most minimal possible non-narrating fix (just '3' -> '5', zero mention that it changed). This is a MEANINGFUL NEGATIVE RESULT for FPO #12: if the Validator reflexively rejected all non-narrating corrections, this maximally-terse case should have been the easiest one to trip -- it wasn't. This nuances FPO #12 usefully: the miscalibration in 005/007 (and possibly 009/010, see their notes) looks like it's triggered by something more specific than bare absence of history-narration -- likely tied to optional-parameter or removed-feature framing rather than simple default-value updates. Recommend citing this case alongside 005/007 when FPO #12 is finally acted on, so the fix targets the actual trigger rather than over-correcting for all non-narrating text.
